fact: As at August 2021, all calls received and responded to at the South Sudan National Police Service's Wau Emergency Call Centre are recorded by hand by response operators in call registers, alongside computerised templates; the centre, opened in February 2019 after a 2014 Juba pilot, is supported by UNDP with funding from Japan and the Netherlands. The record is the call centre's, not a station's occurrence book.
title: Crime reporting on speed dial: Responsiveness of Wau Police Emergency Call Centre
